title: 50:6 back/smiter/cheeks/plucked off the hair. The servant submitted himself to great insult for his testimony (Jer. 20:7-9). "The striking language calls to mind . . . the physical sufferings of our Lord (cf. Matt. 26:67ff; John 19:1ff). . . . Beating on the back would seem also to be the custom in [punishing] evil men (cf. Prov. 10:13; 19:29; 26:3; Ps. 129:3).
author: Tina M. Peterson
